title: Six blocks yield a parity tuple
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $d$, a choice of six ordered, pairwise disjoint $d$-element subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ determines a tuple of four subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. Each of the four sets has size $3d$, and every element belongs to an even number of the four sets.
hypotheses_covered: The input consists of six ordered, pairwise disjoint $d$-element subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
caveat: The construction uses an upstream incident-support operation whose definition is not included in the supplied definitions; the output properties are specified by the formal type.
